name: skills-open-questions
description: /open-questions across the week's meetings: the questions asked and never answered (the old annual price, who updates the pricing page, the van's insurance), not the ones answered (the free plan, the launch email's day).

transcript.text: Do we keep the free plan after the price change?
Yes, the free plan stays, we agreed that last month.
What do we tell customers who signed up on the old annual price?
Good question. I don't know yet.
And who updates the pricing page before the change goes live?
Let's come back to that. Next, the launch email.
When does the launch email go out?
The new van arrives on Monday.
Is the van insured from day one, or do we need to sort that?
I'm honestly not sure, the dealer didn't say.
Okay. Who drives it on the first run?
Sam does the first run, that's agreed.
